# add mergestat as docker image

Run [MergeStat](https://github.com/mergestat/mergestat) (the renamed askgit, SQL over git history) from its Docker image rather than as a locally installed binary — the Homebrew formula had been failing ([[DOT-193]]) and the image sidesteps the build. The pattern is the one later used for Whisper in [bin/lib/ai.bash](../../bin/lib/ai.bash): a function that mounts the current directory into a `docker run --rm` of the image.
